About

From another barrio.

Alien Vato is a Chicano artist from San Diego making the music he couldn’t find anywhere else: hip-hop colliding with electronic, lowrider culture colliding with outer space. Green and purple. Barrio and beyond.

His first single, “Leave Me Alone Vato,” says it plain — unbothered, self-made, and doing it his own way. The run is already moving: LMAV is out on all platforms, and he’s battling in the Top 5 round of Next Music Star with a Jingle Ball stage on the line.

The debut album lands January 22, 2027. Until then — vote daily, stream LMAV, and watch the sky over the 619.

  • FromSan Diego, California — the 619
  • SoundHip-hop × electronic, with rock in the blend
  • Biggest inspirationOliver Tree — “loved his freedom”
  • Dream collabCypress Hill
  • If he wins the $10K“Reinvest it into myself.”
